reviews.text: Dr. Caruso has saved our dog Toby’s life three times now. First, she found and removed his cancer. Next when he started crying in the middle of the night every night and we thought he was at end of life, she recommended a dietary change that cured him, then when his old age set in and he developed dementia and had severe sundowning anxiety and indoor urination, she recommended a medication that has given us our sweet boy back! It feels like a miracle. We trust Dr Caruso with all of our animals. She genuinely cares for them all. We are incredibly thankful.
I Brought my 5yr old Pomeranian in for stomach issues. We were all treated great,he's an anxious dog but was handled well. Was put on probiotics. Also updated all of his vaccinations. Good vet....

I had a bad experience with this vet went to her for a second opinion.she took blood and said something is eating her red blood cells.when I asked what several visits I got the same answer.that was in February by April I had to put my 6 year old and 4 months to sleep her blood count was so so low.i feel she killed my dog by not knowing or trying to find out what was wrong with my baby.snd tryed to give my 5 months old puppy a shot that she already had.glad i didn’t let her hurt my puppy.my new vet told me she had all her shots.so i know i was right.Dr Caroso is not a very good vet stay away she will not help your animal

We recently decided to adopt a kitten. The shelter referred us to our regular veterinary clinic—the one where we’ve been taking our other cat for a long time. When we went to see the kitten, an immediate bond formed between it and my son; the little one even climbed right into his arms on its own.
Since English isn't my native language, I approached the reception desk simply to ask about the adoption process.
When we returned the next day to speak with the vet, we were met with a hostile atmosphere. The receptionist made baseless claims that we had shouted and behaved rudely. Without giving us a chance to explain, the vet refused to speak to us, ordered us to leave, and wouldn't say where the kitten was.
We simply wanted to adopt the animal, and my son had been perfectly calm the entire time. Separating a child from an animal he had bonded with so deeply—all because of a false accusation—was incredibly unfair and painful. It felt as though they simply didn't want to let us have the kitten. How can I possibly go back there after everything that happened? I don't think I'll be going there anymore.
Very grateful for helping my dog! Prices were very reasonable. We also came to neuter our dog and it went great

Dr. Caruso took good care of my dog who I brought in with an ear infection.  She was kind, caring and informative and answered several questions that I had.  I was able to get an appointment within a couple hours of calling.
Was able to spay a wild cat that kept coming to eat at my house

I brought my dog in for surgery to remove a benign cyst, and everything went really well. You can barely tell he had surgery unless you look very closely at his face. The procedure was expensive, but it was still the most affordable option compared to all the other places I researched.

The doctor was very kind, and so was her staff. They took great care of my dog, and I’m really happy with the outcome. will come back again for whatever my Momo needs

They accommodate you right away.
I'm happy with their service
The best Animal Hospital in New York.  Doctors are dedicated professionals who care about your pet not your wallet.  I recommend them to all my friends and aqaintances...

Faithful Friends is a very clean facility and they did an excellent job helping my cat out with an infection. They managed to identify the issue and help him out and did a great job with it. The doctors were very kind and understanding as well

I knock to door of this "hospital" with literaly dieing kitten on my hands.
Lady's voice even DECLANE open the door, and merceless told me: "We work by appoitment only!.."
I did not look for free service. I was ready to pay as many as they may ask, to save life for 3-days kitten which I just rescue on my driveway...
Thanks G-d, another clinic was opening doors for me...

I am so grateful to faithful friends! I have a community cat who completely stopped eating and FF were able to do bloodwork and a full dental extraction within a week. The whole staff were truly wonderful and answered all of my questions. Most importantly - it was a very affordable price. Several other NYC vets quoted me almost double the cost. Can’t recommend them enough.

I have seen a few different vets here over the years, pretty positive experience overall, but I've had a couple appointments recently with Dr. Caruso that were honestly awful. She made me sit in the corner while she and the vet tech examined my cats, I understand the need for space to do their job, but she was very curt and forceful about it. She made me feel really rushed and I didn't get a chance to talk about anything. I was in there for 5 min tops.

One of my cats has a broken tooth, like fully broken to the base, and she told me it needs to be extracted. That makes sense. But then I brought my other cat (5 yrs old) in for a check up and she said he has 6 questionable teeth, 2 of which definitely need to be removed, if not all?? When I asked her how it happens she was super patronizing and rude and said "imagine if you didn't brush your teeth your whole life".  And I asked her if regular tooth brushing and cleaning at the vet would help and she was dismissive and said it would help symptoms but not solve the issue. She didn't even suggest a dental cleaning. It was like going to a mechanic who doesn't show or explain anything to you and then swindles you by making you think the situation is way worse than it is.

I doubt I'll be going back to this place.
